title: Short-term liquidity investment allocation
prompt:
Allocate excess corporate cash across approved short-term instruments.

Begin with the July liquidity, banking, and covenant-outlook thread in `Requests/`, including the bank follow-up. Use the current controller-tied workpapers and operating extracts, keeping earlier versions only for comparison. Resolve conflicts using dates, approvals, document status, and management correspondence. Reconcile posted Alder Ridge balances through the contractor-accounting MCP; keep external targets, peer data, bank terms, and market evidence tied to their controlling finance sources.

Preserve daily operating and payroll cash floors, then allocate only excess cash. Enforce bank counterparty limits, FDIC-insured capacity, maximum weighted-average maturity, minimum same-day liquidity, and approved instrument ratings. Maximize annualized interest income using the quoted yields; do not allocate restricted cash. Return allocations by instrument, expected annual interest, weighted-average maturity, same-day-liquid principal in dollars under `same_day_liquidity`, and unused investable cash.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `operating_money_market_allocation`, `treasury_bill_allocation`, `government_fund_allocation`, `insured_sweep_allocation`, `expected_annual_interest`, `weighted_average_maturity_days`, `same_day_liquidity`, `unused_investable_cash`. Use dollars to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals, and lists as JSON arrays.
